text: GuHong injection, an intravenous herbal formulation, is licensed by the Chinese NMPA as an adjunct therapy for ischemic stroke and related symptoms. Each milliliter of GuHong comprises an aqueous extract of 0.5 g Carthamus tinctorius flowers (known as “Honghua” in Chinese) and 30 mg of N-acetyl-L-glutamine.
